description: Buys an item from agentPickup's marketplace at its listed price, for the person to pick up in person. Reserves it for 30 minutes and returns Stripe's payment page: the person pays there themselves. Their card is held, not charged, until they collect the item and the seller confirms the handover. Check the item and the price with them first. Needs sign-in.
name: buy_listing
title: Buy an item
